name: sambla-media-stream
description: WebSocket bridge between Twilio Media Streams and OpenAI Realtime API. Each Twilio inbound call lands on wss://host/ws/media-stream; this service resolves the call's bot context, opens a parallel WS to OpenAI Realtime, transcodes audio (Twilio mulaw 8kHz ↔ OpenAI PCM16 24kHz), and handles barge-in / DTMF / call teardown.
